meta.description: Deep generative models for single-cell omics. Use when you need probabilistic batch correction (scVI), transfer learning, differential expression with uncertainty, or multi-modal integration (TOTALVI, MultiVI). Best for advanced modeling, batch effects, multimodal data. For standard analysis pipelines use scanpy.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation accurately represents scvi-tools 1.4.3 capabilities with correct model namespaces and theoretical foundations

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for probabilistic modeling in single-cell genomics; clear boundaries directing standard analysis to scanpy

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established variational inference methods, deep generative models, and peer-reviewed scvi-tools publications

code_usability.detail: All code examples follow the correct API pattern (setup_anndata, train, extract); syntactically correct with proper imports

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of scvi-tools ecosystem including RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, multimodal, spatial, and specialized models; excellent reference organization by modality; minor: could benefit from more concrete model selection decision trees

reliability.note: Good guidance on model persistence, batch correction patterns, and theoretical foundations; minor: lacks explicit troubleshooting section for common training failures (convergence, GPU memory errors)

performance_context.note: Well-structured documentation with clear sections, comprehensive reference files organized by modality (8 files covering all model categories)

agent_usability.note: Excellent 'When to Use This Skill' section with clear triggers; strong scope boundaries to scanpy; comprehensive examples; minor: model namespace warning is excellent but could be more prominent

human_usability.note: Clear installation with Python 3.12+ requirement; excellent workflow example; compute backend options documented; best practices section included

security.note: No credential exposure; safe data handling patterns; raw counts requirement properly emphasized; no security concerns identified

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.1, license (BSD-3-Clause), comprehensive reference organization by modality, clear API patterns, version-specific notes (1.4.3)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with scanpy ecosystem; clear integration with AnnData; theoretical foundations documented; minor: lacks explicit output format specifications for different model types and could benefit from more explicit failure modes

key_strengths: Exceptional model organization by modality (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, multimodal, spatial, specialized) with 8 comprehensive reference files
Clear and prominent model namespace documentation preventing critical import errors (scvi.model vs scvi.external)
Strong theoretical foundations section grounding the skill in variational inference and deep generative modeling principles
Excellent unified API pattern documentation (setup → train → extract) consistent across all models
Outstanding integration with scanpy ecosystem and clear scope boundaries for when to use scvi-tools vs scanpy

recommendations.title: Add troubleshooting section for common training failures
recommendations.problem: No guidance on GPU memory errors, convergence issues, or training diagnostics
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation focuses on successful workflows without addressing common failure modes
recommendations.fix: Add troubleshooting section covering: GPU OOM errors and batch size tuning, convergence diagnostics (ELBO plots), NaN losses, and when to adjust learning rates or epochs

recommendations.title: Expand transfer learning documentation
recommendations.problem: Transfer learning mentioned as use case but workflow not documented
recommendations.root_cause: scANVI transfer learning pattern not shown despite being a key feature
recommendations.fix: Add transfer learning example to main SKILL.md showing: train base model on reference, load for query dataset, handle feature alignment, and extract transferred annotations

recommendations.title: Add model selection decision tree
recommendations.problem: Many models available but selection criteria spread across descriptions
recommendations.root_cause: Users must read all model descriptions to understand which fits their data type
recommendations.fix: Add decision tree or flowchart: 'Do you have protein data? → Yes: totalVI/MultiVI. Is it paired? → Yes: totalVI, No: MultiVI. Are datasets unpaired? → DIAGVI' etc.
